title: CreateTestRequest
description: Operator (Controller) -> server-main body of POST /api/v1/tests. The operator authors WHAT to run as a port-less TestPlan; the server owns the bindings. test-control allocates one port per flow (flow_bindings) and a server_host, assembles the RunTestPayload, and enqueues RUN_TEST for the device. Because TestPlan is now port-less, `plan` is exactly a TestPlan — no separate flow definitions live here.

device_id.description: Target device (server-assigned id from enrollment). One device per request; multi-device fan-out is a Controller-side loop in MVP.

plan.description: The port-less plan to run. Identical shape to what is embedded in header.json.

logging_config_override.description: Optional per-test logging config; server still enforces effective ⊆ capability before sending.
